summary: Enhance your expertise with our Retirement Plan Design and Implementation Training Course. Learn to create effective retirement solutions for clients.
lede: Retirement plan design involves shaping benefits, contributions, and governance around employee needs and organizational goals. For HR, benefits, finance, and plan governance professionals, this course covers choosing plan structures, assessing costs and risks, and planning an implementation or redesign. It also addresses evaluating benefit adequacy and communicating plan changes clearly to employees.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who influence or manage retirement and pension arrangements, ensuring they are competitive and aligned with organizational goals.
audience: HR managers and HR business partners
Trustees and board members of pension funds
modules: Understanding Retirement Plan Types and Structures
Investment Strategy and Risk Management in Retirement Plans
Governance and Administration of Retirement Plans
Cost, Value, and Performance Evaluation of Retirement Plans
Employee Communication and Engagement on Retirement Benefits
Implementing New or Redesigned Retirement Plans
Strategic Review and Future-Proofing Retirement Plans
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of HR practices and employee benefits. Prior experience in managing or influencing retirement plans is beneficial but not mandatory.
